about.label: About ProAffy
about.heading: We're Not a Chatbot Company. We're an HVAC Growth Partner.
about.intro: At ProAffy, we focus on one thing: helping HVAC companies book more jobs and stop losing money on leads that slip through the cracks.
about.story.heading: The Problem We Kept Seeing
about.story.p1: We saw the same problem over and over again. HVAC owners spending real money on ads and getting real leads, but losing a huge chunk of them simply because nobody followed up fast enough, or at all.
about.story.p2: Calls go to voicemail. Texts go unanswered for hours. Old leads pile up in a CRM and never get touched again. That's not a marketing problem. That's a follow-up problem. And it's costing HVAC companies thousands every single month.
about.built.heading: So We Built the ThermoGrowth Engine
about.built.body: A complete system that fills your pipeline with leads, responds to every single one within 60 seconds, books qualified jobs straight into your calendar, and follows up automatically until a lead either books or says no.
approach.heading: Our Approach
approach.item1: No tech headaches. We build it, install it, and run it. You don't have to learn new software or manage another tool.
approach.item2: No guesswork. You see real leads, real bookings, and real numbers. Not promises.
approach.item3: No risk. We prove it works with a free pilot before you commit to anything.
mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: Help HVAC companies grow without hiring more office staff, without losing leads to slow response times, and without leaving money on the table from cold leads sitting in their system. We don't sell software. We don't sell "AI" as a buzzword. We build and run a system that gets your phone ringing, your calendar full, and your technicians out on more jobs, every single month.
